The developer has worked on 30 residential projects in Bangalore and other cities including 14 ongoing projects. Developer Profile
Brigade Group is a Bangalore-based real estate company focussed on providing world-class property solutions including luxury apartments, commercial spaces, retail spaces and hospitality projects. The builder has a multi-domain portfolio encompassing property management services, education, property development and hospitality. Founded in 1986, the group has a presence in major cities of South India like Kochi, Chennai, Hyderabad, Mysore and Bangalore. An accredited agent in the USA, the developer also has a representative office in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
Brigade Group has won the Best Office Space Award - World Trade Center Bangalore and Brigade Gateway at the CREDAI Real Estate Awards Karnataka 2013. It has been ranked among India's top 10 builders for consistent five years from 2007 to 2011 by Construction World. It has also received the CRISIL Rating PA2, 1995.
Experience and Strengths
The corporate philosophy of Brigade Group includes a stable and confident business model as well as processes involving innovation. The developer is environmentally conscious and develops projects in strict compliance with applicable regulations and best practices. It has been certified in ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2004 (Environmental Management Systems), 2008. The brand has gained the trust and admiration of numerous customers owing to its reliable services. It strives to retain its position of being the preferred developer of residential, commercial and hospitality spaces in the market by staying committed to its goals.
The team at Brigade Group is led by Chairman and Managing Director, M.R. Jaishankar, and Director, M.R. Gurumurthy. Several projects and concepts pioneered by the developer have been a huge success and created landmarks which changed the urban landscape. For instance, Brigade Towers was the first 14-storied building in Bangalore; Brigade Millennium at JP Nagar was Bangalore's first integrated enclave project launched in 2002, and Brigade Gateway at Rajajinagar is another prestigious development in Bangalore that was recognised as the most integrated city-centric mixed-use project.
The builder has partnered with some of the best-known architects, master planners, contractors, suppliers and consultants in the industry. Construction of properties using cutting-edge technology is one of the biggest strengths of Brigade Group. The company has been on the forefront when it comes to using new technologies like in-house pre-cast technology. Besides complying with international standards for delivering a high-quality product, the developer also adheres to the timelines. Moreover, it has launched an online portal for tracking project progress and payments; and an online booking platform for home-buying that has offered the best customer experience.
Projects
In 32 years, Brigade Group has grown rapidly and developed over 20 million square feet of real estate space. Brigade Metropolis at Whitefield, Bangalore is an award-winning 40-acre residential development. The developer has worked on 30 residential projects in Bangalore and other cities including 14 ongoing projects. It offers 1, 2 and 3BHK apartments sized between 800 sqft and 2,000 sqft; as well as spacious 4BHK and 5BHK apartments sized above 3,000 sqft.
